title: UDisc Round Rating Personal Best Detection
dataSources: Golf rounds (`golf:round`), Garmin golf telemetry (`garmin:golf`), UDisc rounds (`udisc:round`), launch-monitor shots (`launchmonitor:shot`), handicap-index updates (`handicap:index`).
app: Arccos and Garmin S62 round telemetry, UDisc round exports, launch-monitor CSVs, and handicap-index updates streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted imports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=udisc:round
| sort 0 _time
| streamstats max(round_rating) as prior_best current=f
| where isnotnull(prior_best) AND round_rating>prior_best
| table _time course_name round_rating prior_best
description: Scans your udisc round rating history in time order and highlights any entry that set a new personal best using the higher metric direction.
value: Automatic personal-best detection turns long history tables into a clean milestone log that is motivating and easy to review.
implementation: Keep the underlying metric normalized across sessions so the best-detection logic compares like events with like events.
visualization: Table of personal-best events with the previous best beside the new value.
grandmaExplanation: It measures the moments when udisc round rating reached a new best for you.
